a.en: Drag around an object in the video to register it, then choose Object mouse in the Mouse panel and pick the object. By default, moving it sideways moves the cursor left/right and moving it toward/away from the camera moves it up/down. The object mouse only moves the cursor and has no click of its own. For clicks, connect the object card's jack to the Mouse click function jack so lifting the object slightly clicks. If needed, run quick auto calibration: hold still, then sweep left-right and near-far. Try it in the virtual desktop first, and turn on real Mac control separately in Output.

a.en: It is described as working with things like a cup on your desk or an ordinary pen. An object with a clear color that stands out from the background works best. It is built to recognize several objects at once and to remember and re-find them after they are hidden. There are no results from testing every kind of item.

a.en: Check that the hand card in Objects is enabled, then select Hand mouse in Mouse. The palm position in the video moves the cursor by default. Thumb–index pinch holds the left button and supports dragging; thumb–middle pinch holds the right button. Extend index and middle, fold thumb, ring and little fingers, and move up/down to scroll. Keep the whole hand visible and practice inside the app first.

a.en: There is a feature for drawing and clicking with a pen, and also for drawing with your index finger. The pen feature is still Beta. How well it finds the pen tip and decides whether it touches the surface can change with camera position, occlusion and lighting, so calibrate before use. It has been checked on only 2 test videos, so we cannot yet say how well it works in other settings.

a.en: The old one-hand hybrid that switched between object and hand, and the finger click for the object mouse, have both been removed. The object mouse now does not track hands at all and only moves the cursor. Click with the hand mouse's pinch, or connect a hand or object card jack to a function jack such as Mouse click. Putting the object down does not switch mouse modes automatically.

a.en: There is no automatic hybrid switching or hand click for the object mouse now. The hand mouse's pinch click and hand-jack buttons work, but their success rate with real hands and cameras has not been measured enough. Hidden fingers can cause wrong or missed presses. Practice on the virtual screen with your whole hand visible, and adjust pinch sensitivity if needed.

a.ko: 내 움직임에 맞춰 커서 방향과 감도를 맞추는 과정이에요. 물체를 먼저 등록하고 대상을 고른 뒤 자동 보정을 여세요. 기본은 잠깐 멈추기, 현재 위치에서 좌우 왕복, 앞뒤 또는 영상 위아래 왕복이에요. 매번 중앙으로 원위치할 필요가 없고, 클릭·스크롤 보정은 선택해서 추가해요. 결과를 보고 적용하거나 취소할 수 있으며 선택하지 않거나 건너뛴 설정은 그대로 남아요. 펜은 닿음·들기 검사도 따로 진행해요.
a.en: Calibration fits cursor direction and sensitivity to your movement. Register and select an object before opening it. The default flow is a brief pause, a left/right sweep from wherever you are, then near/far or up/down in the video. No return to the center is required, and click/scroll checks are optional. Review before applying or cancel; unselected or skipped settings stay unchanged. Pen calibration also checks contact and lifting.

a.en: Name the setup and press Save in Mapping to keep its connections as a profile. Next time, register objects and choose the profile from Load. Profiles find current objects by name, so use distinct names. Renaming preserves current connections, but save again if you want the new name used later. This does not automatically register objects on the next run. Reset all settings keeps saved profiles.

a.en: Objects that look alike can be hard to track. It may follow the wrong one, so it is better to use objects with clearly different colors or shapes. If it gets confused, reselect the object or recalibrate.

a.en: It is built to remember an object and find it again after it is hidden. Still, an object that is largely covered by a hand can be hard to track. In that case hold it so it stays visible, or reselect it.

a.en: First check that camera access is allowed on your Mac. Quit any other app using the camera and press Refresh devices in the app's Camera panel. If the iPhone Continuity Camera is not in the list, connect the iPhone to the Mac with a USB cable, tap 'Trust This Computer' on the iPhone, then refresh again. Also check the same Apple Account, Continuity Camera turned on, and Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

a.en: Check that both devices are signed in to the same Apple Account with two-factor authentication, and that Continuity Camera is on in iPhone settings. Turn on Wi-Fi and Bluetooth and keep them close. If you connected by USB, make sure you tapped to trust this computer on the iPhone, then refresh the camera list in the app.

a.ko: 조명을 밝게 하고 카메라와 물체를 고정해 보세요. 배경과 구분되는 물체를 쓰고, 다시 선택하거나 보정해 보세요. 한두 순간 튀는 움직임을 눌러 주는 기능(튐 억제)은 기본으로 켜져 있어요. 다만 이 기능이 커서를 얼마나 부드럽게 해 주는지는 따로 재 보지 못했어요.
a.en: Brighten the lighting and keep the camera and object steady. Use an object that stands out from the background, then reselect or recalibrate. A feature that dampens sudden one-moment jumps (spike guard) is on by default. However, we have not measured how much smoother it makes the cursor.
